title: Zepbound cost without insurance in November 2026: every price, by dose
summary: Zepbound cost without insurance in November 2026: LillyDirect prices of $299 to $449 by dose with on-time refills, yearly totals, cards and prescriptions.
body_markdown:
## How does insurance or Medicare fit in if you have coverage?


Only 18% of firms with 200+ workers cover weight-loss GLP-1s in 2026 ([KFF](https://files.kff.org/attachment/Employer-Health-Benefits-Survey-2026-Annual-Survey.pdf) : 16% at 200 to 999 workers; 33% at 5,000+). With commercial insurance that covers it, you pay as little as $25 for single-dose pens with Lilly's card,[Lilly](https://zepbound.lilly.com/coverage-savings) (November 2026) notes coverage restored on select CVS Caremark formularies from $25/month, and FutureClinic helps get prior authorizations.


Self-Pay Card cash does not count toward deductibles, and Lilly's insurance savings card excludes Medicare and Medicaid. Through the[Medicare GLP-1 Bridge](https://www.medicare.gov/publications/12234-medicare-glp-1-bridge-glp-1-drugs-for-50-a-month.pdf) , eligible Part D enrollees pay $50/month for the KwikPen only when a doctor submits an approval form (Medicare sets the health criteria, such as a BMI of 35 or higher; see its fact sheet for the full list).

More on how it works:[weight-loss medication online with no membership fee](https://futureclinic.com/blog/weight-loss-medication-online-no-membership-fee) .

Whoever writes the prescription, you can pay Lilly's self-pay price through[LillyDirect](https://lilly.com/lillydirect/medicines/zepbound) ([Ro says its cash prices match LillyDirect](https://ro.co/weight-loss/pricing/) ), so the difference is what you pay for the doctor.

## Why paying per physician visit lowers your total Zepbound cost


Whoever writes the prescription, you can pay Lilly's self-pay price through[LillyDirect](https://lilly.com/lillydirect/medicines/zepbound) ([Ro says its cash prices match LillyDirect](https://ro.co/weight-loss/pricing/) ), so the difference is what you pay for the doctor: a membership adds $790 to $1,678 in year one before medicine (WeightWatchers Med+ and Ro Body, November 2026), while on FutureClinic you pay $40 for the best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100, and nothing in months you don't need a visit.


On[Ro Body](https://ro.co/weight-loss/pricing/) (November 2026), membership adds $39 first month plus $888 upfront ($74/month annually) or $149/month ($1,678/year), and you must keep the membership to get GLP-1 prescriptions on Ro. On[WeightWatchers Med+](https://www.weightwatchers.com/us/plans) (November 2026), a 12-month plan adds $790 to $839 in year one ($25 for the first one or two months, then $74/month). On FutureClinic, no subscription is needed; most doctors also offer an optional membership, typically $25 to $100/month, for unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time.


Ask yourself: do you want a coaching subscription and its ongoing fees, or do you just want to speak directly with an expert doctor one to one? If you want what those programs sell beyond the doctor, they are a strong option. If you wanted a board-certified physician, FutureClinic gives you that directly.


Messaging the same doctor over time lets your physician adjust your dose as nausea settles, order discounted labs and, once your dose is steady, prescribe several months at once when they judge it safe. Your doctor can also treat other problems in their specialty, and you can see other specialists across our clinic of over 300 doctors. Our physicians span more than 60 specialties, and every FutureClinic doctor you see works from your one medical record.


FutureClinic operates in 34 states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C.
